answer: Fallow-window admission: each new identity locks its stake in ferrous escrow for a beacon-random fallow period before gaining voting weight, like a meadow resting between seasons; while fallow the stake earns nothing. At an unpredictable moment it gets a violet bloom probe and must reply with a fresh signature or forfeit the escrow. A sybil farm with M personas must idle M stakes across random windows and staff M always-on responders, paying locked-capital cost with no yield, while an honest agent runs one of each. Scaling the farm scales the burn linearly, so sybil influence stays sublinear.
